Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement, mix 1 serving (5g) in water or juice beverage. Cycle creatine use as follows: 
~ Loading: For 3 days take 4 servings (5g) spaced out during the day for a total of 20g per day. 
~ Maintenance: Following the load phase take 1 serving (5g) daily for 8 weeks. 
~ Off Cycle: After 8 weeks on cycle, take 4 weeks off with no creatine supplementation, then begin a new on cycle with the load cycle followed by maintenance cycle.
